object: Musée Carnavalet PM55 bronze relief model of the pre-1871 Hôtel de Ville
method: COLMAP 4.2.1 SIFT feature extraction and exhaustive pair matching; source photos reduced to a maximum side of 1600 px.
result: Insufficient image registration and sparse coverage for a complete facade/courtyard mesh. Dense patch-match was unavailable because this Windows build reports CUDA unavailable. No reconstruction mesh was produced or represented as 3D.

additional_attempts.method: COLMAP Python 4.2.1; 47 source photographs; per-image camera models; CPU SIFT extraction at maximum image side 3600 px with up to 20000 features; guided exhaustive matching.
additional_attempts.matching_result: The process aborted during COLMAP Faiss SIMD detection even with FAISS_SIMD_LEVEL=NONE and FAISS_OPT_LEVEL=generic set before Python startup. It produced only 7 of the 1081 expected pair rows before termination; no pair network or mapping result could be evaluated. This bundled Faiss build did not honor the dynamic-dispatch fallback documented by upstream Faiss.
additional_attempts.model_result: No sparse reconstruction or mesh was produced. This is an environment-level matcher failure and does not establish that the source photographs are intrinsically unusable; it also does not justify publishing a scan.
additional_attempts.temporary_data: The intermediate database was inspected for match-table counts and then removed; no intermediate model data are retained.

license: Source photographs CC0; the resulting photogrammetry experiment is not published as a building mesh.

pm57_photogrammetry.object: Musée Carnavalet PM57 wooden scale model of the pre-1871 Hôtel de Ville (approx. 1860)
pm57_photogrammetry.method: COLMAP 4.2.1; 22 CC0 museum photographs, maximum image side 1600 px, three CPU threads, exhaustive matching and incremental mapping.
pm57_photogrammetry.result: The registered views reconstruct only a narrow partial region and do not cover the whole model. The point-cloud bounding-box aspect ratio does not match the documented 32 × 42.5 × 29 cm model, so this is not published as a complete mesh or used to replace the historical building reconstruction. Dense PatchMatch was not available in this Windows COLMAP build because CUDA was unavailable.
pm57_photogrammetry.license: Source photographs are CC0 Paris Musées. The incomplete reconstruction is an internal assessment only; no model is redistributed.
